title: Distributed and Private Textual Data Synthesis from Embeddings
authors: Ergute Bao, Hongyan Chang, Ali Shahin Shamsabadi, Ting Yu, Xiaokui Xiao
summary: Combines differential privacy and cryptographic protocols to synthesize text from distributed users without a trusted raw-data curator.

title: Watermark Basins: Black-Box Detection of Distilled LLMs
authors: Hongyan Chang, Hady Elsahar, Tom Sander, Pierre Fernandez, Saeed Mahloujifar, Sylvestre-Alvise Rebuffi, Tomáš Souček, Tuan Tran, Valeriu Lacatusu, Surya Parimi, Rashel Moritz, Vanessa Stark, Alexandre Mourachko
summary: Detects model distillation from API-generated text by testing for a persistent, key-specific watermark signal using a clean probe model.

title: TextSeal: A Localized LLM Watermark for Provenance & Distillation Protection
authors: Tom Sander, Hongyan Chang, Tomáš Souček, Tuan Tran, Valeriu Lacatusu, Sylvestre-Alvise Rebuffi, Alexandre Mourachko, Surya Parimi, Christophe Ropers, Rashel Moritz, Vanessa Stark, Hady Elsahar, Pierre Fernandez
summary: Introduces localized text watermarking that preserves generation quality and diversity while enabling provenance and distillation detection.

title: Overcoming the Retrieval Barrier: Indirect Prompt Injection in the Wild for LLM Systems
authors: Hongyan Chang, Ergute Bao, Xinjian Luo, Ting Yu
summary: Shows how poisoned documents can overcome retrieval barriers and trigger end-to-end prompt injection in RAG and agent systems.

title: Image Prompt Reconstruction Attacks on Distributed MLLM Inference Frameworks
authors: Xinjian Luo, Hongyan Chang, Jianxin Wei, Yuncheng Wu, Xiaofeng Gao, Meikang Qiu, Ting Yu, Xue Liu
summary: Reconstructs private image prompts from intermediate embeddings to expose privacy risks in distributed multimodal inference.

title: Watermark Smoothing Attacks against Language Models
authors: Hongyan Chang, Hamed Hassani, Reza Shokri
summary: Exposes watermark vulnerabilities through confidence-guided edits that remove statistical signals while preserving text quality.

title: Context-Aware Membership Inference Attacks against Pre-trained Large Language Models
authors: Hongyan Chang, Ali Shahin Shamsabadi, Kleomenis Katevas, Hamed Haddadi, Reza Shokri
summary: Audits LLM training-data membership by adapting statistical tests to how token predictability changes with context.

title: Efficient Privacy Auditing in Federated Learning
authors: Hongyan Chang, Brandon Edwards, Anindya S. Paul, Reza Shokri
summary: Audits membership privacy efficiently by tracking changes in model confidence and loss across federated training rounds.

title: On the Impact of Machine Learning Randomness on Group Fairness
authors: Prakhar Ganesh, Hongyan Chang, Martin Strobel, Reza Shokri
summary: Identifies data-order randomness as a major source of unstable group fairness and shows how changing data order can affect fairness.

title: Bias Propagation in Federated Learning
summary: Explains how local bias spreads through federated training and increases dependence on sensitive attributes.

title: Cronus: Robust and Heterogeneous Collaborative Learning with Black-Box Knowledge Transfer
authors: Hongyan Chang*, Virat Shejwalkar*, Reza Shokri, Amir Houmansadr
summary: Builds robust collaboration among heterogeneous models through black-box knowledge transfer instead of sharing model parameters.
equal_contribution: Hongyan Chang and Virat Shejwalkar contributed equally.

title: On the Privacy Risks of Algorithmic Fairness
summary: Shows that fairness constraints can increase membership leakage disproportionately for underprivileged groups.

title: On Adversarial Bias and the Robustness of Fair Machine Learning
authors: Hongyan Chang, Ta Duy Nguyen, Sasi Kumar Murakonda, Ehsan Kazemi, Reza Shokri
summary: Studies how data poisoning can undermine the accuracy and fairness of models trained with group-fairness constraints.
